name: filmstrip
description: Tile a uniform time-grid of frames into filmstrip contact sheets, with an index JSON mapping every tile to its timestamp. Pure ffmpeg. Feeds a timeline scrubber thumbnail strip — unlike shot_sheet this samples on a fixed time grid, not per detected shot.

input.description: Source video file (all-intra proxy expected for cheap per-tile seeking)

output.description: {sheets:[{path, cols, rows, tiles:[{t, row, col}]}], interval, tileWidth}

params.name: out-dir
params.description: Directory to write sheet images into

params.name: max-tiles
params.description: Total tile budget across the whole filmstrip; bounds interval = max(duration/max-tiles, min-interval)

params.name: tiles-per-sheet
params.description: Tiles per sheet before splitting into another sheet
